question: Show revenue per ticket types per federal state in 2025
sql:
SELECT
    rb.bundesland_name,
    tp.ticket_name,
    tv.jahr,
    SUM(tv.umsatz_eur) AS revenue_eur
FROM ticket_verkaeufe tv
JOIN ticket_produkte tp ON tv.ticket_code = tp.ticket_code
JOIN postleitzahlen p ON CAST(tv.plz AS VARCHAR) = p.plz
JOIN regionen_bundesland rb ON p.bundesland_code2 = rb.bundesland_code2
WHERE tv.jahr = 2025
GROUP BY rb.bundesland_name, tp.ticket_name, tv.jahr
ORDER BY rb.bundesland_name, revenue_eur, tv.jahr DESC

sql: WITH actual AS (SELECT jahr, tarifverbund_id, SUM(umsatz_eur) AS actual_revenue FROM ticket_verkaeufe GROUP BY jahr, tarifverbund_id), plan AS (SELECT jahr, tarifverbund_id, SUM(umsatz_eur) AS planned_revenue FROM plan_umsatz GROUP BY jahr, tarifverbund_id) SELECT t.name AS tarifverbund, a.jahr, a.actual_revenue, p.planned_revenue FROM actual a JOIN plan p ON a.jahr = p.jahr AND a.tarifverbund_id = p.tarifverbund_id JOIN tarifverbuende t ON a.tarifverbund_id = t.tarifverbund_id WHERE a.actual_revenue > p.planned_revenue ORDER BY a.jahr, a.actual_revenue - p.planned_revenue DESC;

question: Show per tariff association the deviation (actual - plan) for 2025.
sql: WITH actual AS (SELECT tarifverbund_id, SUM(umsatz_eur) AS actual_revenue FROM ticket_verkaeufe WHERE jahr = 2025 GROUP BY tarifverbund_id), plan AS (SELECT tarifverbund_id, SUM(umsatz_eur) AS planned_revenue FROM plan_umsatz WHERE jahr = 2025 GROUP BY tarifverbund_id) SELECT t.name AS tarifverbund, actual.actual_revenue, plan.planned_revenue, actual.actual_revenue - plan.planned_revenue AS deviation_eur FROM actual JOIN plan ON actual.tarifverbund_id = plan.tarifverbund_id JOIN tarifverbuende t ON actual.tarifverbund_id = t.tarifverbund_id ORDER BY deviation_eur DESC;

question: Show monthly deviation as a percentage.
sql: WITH actual AS (SELECT jahr, monat, SUM(umsatz_eur) AS actual_revenue FROM ticket_verkaeufe GROUP BY jahr, monat), plan AS (SELECT jahr, monat, SUM(umsatz_eur) AS planned_revenue FROM plan_umsatz GROUP BY jahr, monat) SELECT a.jahr, a.monat, (a.actual_revenue - p.planned_revenue) / NULLIF(p.planned_revenue, 0) * 100 AS deviation_pct FROM actual a JOIN plan p ON a.jahr = p.jahr AND a.monat = p.monat ORDER BY a.jahr, a.monat;

question: Which tariff associations had the highest revenue growth from 2024 to 2025?
sql:
SELECT
    tv.jahr,
    t.name AS tarifverbund_name,
    SUM(tv.umsatz_eur) AS umsatz_eur
FROM ticket_verkaeufe tv
JOIN tarifverbuende t
    ON tv.tarifverbund_id = t.tarifverbund_id
WHERE tv.jahr = 2024 OR tv.jahr = 2025
GROUP BY tv.jahr, t.name
ORDER BY tv.jahr, umsatz_eur DESC

question: which federal states have the highest ticket revenue in june 2024?
sql:
SELECT
    tv.monat,
    rb.bundesland_name,
    SUM(tv.umsatz_eur) AS umsatz_eur
FROM ticket_verkaeufe tv
JOIN postleitzahlen p
    ON CAST(tv.plz AS VARCHAR) = p.plz
JOIN regionen_bundesland rb
    ON p.bundesland_code2 = rb.bundesland_code2
WHERE tv.jahr = 2024
GROUP BY tv.monat, rb.bundesland_name
ORDER BY umsatz_eur DESC
